comment: Unique identifier for this AI provider.
Use a descriptive name like 'watsonx-onprem', 'watsonx-dev', etc.
Provider type identifier.
This value is automatically set based on your selection during gather mode.
WatsonX.ai Lightweight Engine service endpoint URL.
Example: https://watsonx.company.local:9443
Whether this provider is active.
Set to 'false' to temporarily disable without removing configuration.
API key for WatsonX Lightweight Engine authentication.
If API key has special characters, use Base64 encoding with {Base64} prefix.
Username for WatsonX Lightweight Engine authentication.
WatsonX Lightweight Engine version.
Default: 5.4
WatsonX instance identifier.
Default: openshift
WatsonX.ai model identifier.
Available models depend on your LWE deployment.
Whether this is the default model for this provider.
Only ONE model per provider should have default=true.
Maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.
Sampling temperature (0.0-2.0).
Lower values make output more focused and deterministic.
Higher values make output more creative and random.
Default: 0.0
Maximum context window size in tokens.
Common limits: granite-13b-chat-v2: 8192, llama-3-70b: 8192
